name: fetch_push_dense_v0
description: Canonical Gymnasium-Robotics Fetch manipulation benchmark where the robot pushes a block to a target on the table.
notes: FetchPushDense is a canonical goal-conditioned manipulation task with contact-rich block pushing.
Dense reward gives the outer loop a smooth learning signal; success_rate is still logged from info.is_success.
The bundled seed flattens the goal-conditioned observation dict for a simple SAC baseline.
RGB rendering is enabled by default so the live dashboard can show sampled FetchPush frames during training.
